name: GitHub
layout_summary: Top navigation bar: hamburger menu, repository breadcrumb path, 'Type / to search' bar at top-right, '+' create menu, Issues/PRs icons, user avatar. Below header on repo pages: Code, Issues, Pull requests, Actions, Security, Insights tabs. Main area: file tree and README.md below.
avoid_traps: Do NOT manually click through nested folders in a repository when looking for a specific file — press 't' to open the instant file finder.
Only use single-key shortcuts ('/', 's', 't') when no text input is currently focused.

search.visual_fallback: smart_type('Type / to search bar at top', query, submit=true)
search.verify: GitHub search modal opens and submits search query

find_file.visual_fallback: smart_type('Go to file input on repo page', filename, submit=true)
find_file.verify: Repository file finder filters and opens the matching file
